description: This PHP source file is a test interface implementation for GitLab integration in an issue tracker system. It sets up configuration for GitLab API access, tests connection, and demonstrates adding and retrieving issues via the gitlabrestInterface class.

classes.name: gitlabrestInterface
classes.description: A class designed to interact with GitLab's issue tracker API, including methods for connection testing, adding issues, and retrieving issues.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the interface with a project ID and configuration settings.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection to GitLab API is successful.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in GitLab with the given summary and description.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of an issue from GitLab by its issue ID.
